title: State Government's Obligation to Establish a State Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission

content.scenario: The State Government of Maharashtra has not yet established a State Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission. A consumer rights activist files a petition in the High Court to direct the State Government to establish the Commission.
content.outcome: The High Court directs the State Government of Maharashtra to establish a State Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission by notification, as mandated by the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.

user_queries: What is the obligation of the State Government under the Consumer Protection Act?
Can a State Government be directed to establish a Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission?
What is the role of the High Court in ensuring compliance with the Consumer Protection Act?
